## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      4 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 24 juil. 2026 - 8 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Annette Duhon_, 6 oct. 2026, 1/5: "I have abandoned this app. (My issues are still detailed in the review edit history.) I wouldn't have spent so much time on this review if hadn't spent so much dang money on this Galaxy Watch 8, which I REALLY regret. I'm not even mad anymore. I now use Google Health as far as Health Connect will sync to it, and I use Medisafe for tracking my medications."
            2. _Daniel Baumbart_, 27 sept. 2026, 1/5: "202609: app doesn't crash a lot anymore but I can't delete wrong automatic entries in sleep so the data is wrong and will get worse over time :( 202509: crashes a lot since the newest update"
            3. _JWM B_, 24 juil. 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
